text: acct-5d1e2d (mirage): diagnosis of the lease friction. Two rules still block you: (1) a message typed into one account while another interactive session is open is only RELAYED, and the Claude you typed to says 'ask whether to take over'; (2) the chat-owner rule makes an unscheduled account stand down. My fix: your message takes the lease from an interactive session idle over 3 minutes (logged on the board), so any account just works. The edit to tools/coord.py was refused by my permission check (it changes shared coordination code), so it is NOT made. Reply 'yes, change coord.py' (or make the change from the account you're typing in) and it ships. If you can tell me the exact error text you last saw, I'll target it.
